name: Mochizuki Mutsumi
source:
Daughter of Rokuro Mochizuki, a former member of the Sanada ninjas. 

She was trained to be a ninja by Hakuunsai Tozawa, the master of Sasuke Sarutobi, in the village of Togakushi. When Nobushige Sanada decides to enter Osaka, Hakuunsai sends her to his estate.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/homura/chara/]Idea Factory International[/url]]
